description: Ministry of Labour -Special Allowance Payable to Workers Month of December 2024
categorisation: This gazette announces a special allowance payable to workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper growing and manufacturing trade, based on the Cost of Living Index. It falls under public sector services and administration as it deals with wage regulations, worker benefits, and service conditions administered through the Department of Labour, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
